title: Consistency beats talent

scenes.say: Talent that stays home loses to average that shows up.
scenes.visual: an empty desk and chair in a dark room

scenes.say: Showing up daily is the unfair advantage.
scenes.visual: a man opening a laptop at a kitchen table before sunrise

scenes.say: One post. One call. One fix. Every day.
scenes.visual: a wall calendar with every day crossed off, close up

scenes.say: Most people quit before the work has time to pay.
scenes.visual: an empty chair pushed back from a desk, papers left behind

scenes.say: Stay long enough to get good.
scenes.visual: hands typing on a laptop late at night, screen glow on the face

scenes.say: That is how one person builds something real.
scenes.visual: a single lit office window in a dark building at night

scenes.say: Follow for more. Build every day.
scenes.visual: morning light across a city street as shops open

caption: Average that shows up beats talent that stays home.
